constant_locator: Single-instruction linear address candidates include unrelated pages; selected exact source assertions in early-link-and-time-proof.json are the actual evidence.
configuration_writer_locators: No complete CFG or alias model. Normal ABI call-clobber is an assumption. Failure to find the initialization does not exclude indirect writes, copies, other images or runtime configuration.
first_timer_locator: Started before a literal/data region and Capstone stopped after4instructions. Direct call-target start0xfe05cab8 was then used; no absent-function conclusion.
reference_raw_data: Reading zeros at reference SRAM configuration offsets is a raw image observation, not runtime initialization/value proof.
startup_CNTFRQ: 2MHz is a source literal programmed by an entry instruction; actual entry and physical frequency unmeasured.
GPIO_delta_origin: Both timer baselines precede GPIO transitions; loop thresholds must not be labeled measured or exact pulse widths.
web: Two specific GitHub searches returned no results, and opening pinned darwin.c via web returned cache miss. Neither proves upstream absence. Pinned already-captured primary bytes and local hashes remain available.
